description: She wears a floor-length muted navy blue gown with an opaque fitted bodice and low square neckline. Narrow gold and cream geometric woven borders decorate the shoulder strips, neckline, sleeves and central skirt edges. Two circular metal brooches sit near the upper bodice straps. A brown and cream woven sash has decorated circular fastenings and long fringed lengths. A cream embroidered underdress shows at the lower central opening. A blue patterned wrap with pale restrained fur-like edging rests along the arms and hangs at the sides. The elbow-length sleeve arrangement shows lower arms and upper chest. Brown closed shoes appear below the hem. No headgear, armor or weapons appear.
